map.邮箱地址提取器，从文本中自动提取所有邮箱并去重复制，辅助批量联系与名单整理。: Email address extractor that automatically pulls all addresses out of text and deduplicates them for copying, helping with bulk contact and list organization.
map.从通讯录/网页/文档批量抽邮箱：得到可导入邮件平台的地址清单。: Batch-extract emails from contacts, web pages, or documents: get an address list you can import into a mailing platform.
map.线索收集：从公开资料抽取联系方式做初步名册（注意合规）。: Lead collection: extract contact details from public sources to build an initial roster (mind the compliance requirements).
map.数据清洗：校验并去重邮箱列表。: Data cleanup: validate and deduplicate an email list.
map.：文本含「联系：alice@example.com 或 bob_test@mai: : given the text "Contact: alice@example.com or bob_test@mail.cn", the tool extracts two well-formed addresses and deduplicates them; you can export a CSV for bulk sending (with authorization).
map.工具只按格式（local@domain.tld）匹配，不验证能否收发；发送前建议: The tool only matches the format (local@domain.tld) and does not verify whether mail can be sent or received; run an SMTP check or double confirmation before sending to avoid hard bounces.
map.未经同意的群发可能违反反垃圾邮件规定与平台政策；仅对自有授权名单使用，并保留退订: Bulk sending without consent may violate anti-spam rules and platform policies; use it only with your own authorized list and keep an unsubscribe mechanism in place.
